name: moh731V2023HeiFeedingBase
description: MOH 731 (Ver. July 2023) 2.7 Infant Feeding, step 2: HEI follow-ups seen before the end of the period whose return-to-clinic date is on or after its first day (the infants current in the period), excluding test patients, with feeding method, category and MOH 731 code. Carries a flag per 2.7 figure, taken from the MOH 731 code so the order of precedence is the source query's, which the aggregate sums and the patient list filters on.

join.joinCondition: pn.person_name_id = (SELECT pn2.person_name_id FROM amrs.person_name pn2 WHERE pn2.person_id = p.person_id AND pn2.voided = 0 ORDER BY pn2.preferred DESC, pn2.person_name_id DESC LIMIT 1)

expressionOptions.expression: (SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 8 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 28 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT pi.identifier FROM amrs.patient_identifier pi WHERE pi.patient_id = p.person_id AND pi.identifier_type = 45 AND pi.voided = 0 ORDER BY pi.preferred DESC, pi.patient_identifier_id DESC LIMIT 1)

(SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT cn.name ORDER BY cn.name SEPARATOR ', ') FROM amrs.obs f JOIN amrs.concept_name cn ON cn.concept_id = f.value_coded AND cn.locale_preferred = 1 AND cn.voided = 0 WHERE f.encounter_id = b.encounter_id AND f.concept_id = 1151 AND f.voided = 0)

CASE WHEN b.has_ebf = 1 THEN 'Exclusive Breastfeeding (EBF)' WHEN b.has_bf = 1 THEN 'Breastfeeding (BF)' WHEN b.has_nbf = 1 THEN 'Not Breastfeeding (NBF)' WHEN b.has_any = 1 THEN 'Other' ELSE 'Not recorded' END
CASE WHEN b.age_months < 6 AND b.has_ebf = 1 THEN 'HV02-32' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_bf = 1 THEN 'HV02-33' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_nbf = 1 THEN 'HV02-34' END

IF((CASE WHEN b.age_months < 6 AND b.has_ebf = 1 THEN 'HV02-32' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_bf = 1 THEN 'HV02-33' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_nbf = 1 THEN 'HV02-34' END) = 'HV02-32', 1, NULL)

IF((CASE WHEN b.age_months < 6 AND b.has_ebf = 1 THEN 'HV02-32' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_bf = 1 THEN 'HV02-33' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_nbf = 1 THEN 'HV02-34' END) = 'HV02-33', 1, NULL)

IF((CASE WHEN b.age_months < 6 AND b.has_ebf = 1 THEN 'HV02-32' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_bf = 1 THEN 'HV02-33' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_nbf = 1 THEN 'HV02-34' END) = 'HV02-34', 1, NULL)

conditions.conditionExpression: COALESCE(CONCAT_WS(' ', pn.given_name, pn.middle_name, pn.family_name), '') NOT LIKE '%test%'

columns.column: CASE WHEN b.age_months < 6 AND b.has_ebf = 1 THEN 'HV02-32' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_bf = 1 THEN 'HV02-33' WHEN b.age_months BETWEEN 6 AND 24 AND b.has_nbf = 1 THEN 'HV02-34' END
